notes: s017/s018 is the one live judgment call: the relational 'of' is given to the participle as the rectum's lexeme-bearing head (rule 19) while the article keeps 'them that' (rule 41), which leaves the participle's unit discontinuous around it. The competing reading gives 'of them' whole to the article on the analogy of rule 19's suffix-rectum case; I take the accepted division because rule 41 fixes the article's rendering at the supplied pronoun and relative.
The two article morphemes of bay-yôm ha-hûʾ are unrepresented because hûʾ is present to carry the ASV's 'that' (rule 41's limit); 'it' at t057 is added, no object morpheme standing on qārəʾû.
